questions.question: Ruth the Moabitess asked her mother-in-law Naomi to let her do what?

answers.text: Go glean grain in the fields
Find work in the town market

questions.question: While gleaning in the fields, Ruth happened to come to the part of a field belonging to which man?
Boaz told Ruth she had taken refuge under someone's wings. Whose wings did he mean?
What did Naomi tell her daughter-in-law Ruth about Boaz, the man whose field Ruth gleaned in?

answers.text: He is one of their kinsman-redeemers
He is a priest at the tabernacle
He is a judge over all Israel
